name: Toyota 1GR-FE
notes: Modern DOHC V6 (2003+) - factory engine in the 2007+ GRJ-badged 70-series Land Cruisers, 4Runner, Tacoma, FJ Cruiser, and Prado 120/150. Output ranged 236-285hp/365-390Nm across VVT-i vs Dual VVT-i variants and markets - 236hp/365Nm (the earlier VVT-i baseline) used here as representative. No factory frame association seeded here since the GRJ70-series chassis itself is out of scope (newer than this project's 80-series cutoff), but the engine is a real swap-in option into older frames. Modern drive-by-wire ECU - needs the donor harness/ECU like other electronically-controlled engines.
